definitionZh: 边界辐射CSS的短手属性环绕元素外边边缘的角. 可以设定一个半径来制作圆角,也可以设定两个弧度来制作椭圆角.
sourceDefinition: The border-radius CSS shorthand property rounds the corners of an element's outer border edge. You can set a single radius to make circular corners, or two radii to make elliptical corners.
